ret.requirements: Level 60, exported talents, two-handed main hand, at least 12 equipped items.
ret.defaults: Native Unsealed Wrath default APL. Public upstream Ret buffs and consumables; review defaults.json or exact nativeRequest in the local fight library. Exported talents and professions replace preset choices.

disc-raid.requirements: Level 60, at least 31 points in Discipline, at least 12 equipped items.
disc-raid.defaults: Exported talents and professions, no raid buffs or consumables. Override explicitly using local scenario.json.
limitations: No effective HPS or throughput simulation
No overhealing, consumed-absorb, healing AI or healer-competition model
No healing trinket or set-proc ranking
Upstream sheet may omit Holy Specialization extra crit
